questions: Does everyone pay the same fixed amount each round, or can each member pay any amount? Can a member pay more than once in the same round?
Can a round be collected once at least one person has paid, or must every member have paid first?
Are rounds simply numbered 1, 2, 3 and so on? Must they be collected in that order, or can people pay into and collect a later round before an earlier one is finished?
answers: No, record whatever each member actually paid; the pot is the total paid in for that round.
